name: Demon's Dream
source:
Life can be hard, and none knows that better than Tommy, a college student whose history is littered with misfortune that seems to follow him around like a curse. One night, however, everything changes when Tommy goes to bed and consequently wakes up in a nightmare that feels a tad too real for his comfort. What’s more, an infernal presence of unclear intentions has set its eyes on him and stalks him in the shadows of his memories.
What is such a being plotting? Will it keep Tommy’s best interests at heart? And more importantly, when presented with a chance to change the odds to his favor and take what he’s been deprived of all of his life, will Tommy do what's right...?

[From [url=https://redroomcollective.carrd.co/]Red Room Collective[/url]]
translation:
人生有时很艰难，没有人比大学生汤米更明白这一点。他的过去充满不幸，厄运仿佛诅咒般如影随形。然而，某天夜里，一切都改变了：汤米入睡后，醒来却发现自己身处一场真实得令人不安的噩梦。更糟的是，一个意图不明、来自地狱的存在盯上了他，在记忆的阴影中追踪着他。
这个存在究竟在谋划什么？它真的会为汤米着想吗？而更重要的是，当一个扭转命运、夺回一生中被剥夺之物的机会摆在眼前时，汤米还能做出正确的选择吗……？
